title: Local realization of equivariant geometric-point maps
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure, and X,Y etale K-schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Equip their K-geometric points with the action of [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous]. For every equivariant map φ between these actions and every x in X, there is an open neighbourhood U of x and a K-morphism U→Y whose effect on every geometric point of U is φ.

source.place: Tag 03QR, full-faithfulness proof, using Morphisms Tag 02GL

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points], specialized over the unique point of Spec K and transported along the canonical fibre isomorphism, the singleton opens are spectra of finite separable K-extensions. Pick the singleton U at x.

Its embeddings into Ksep form a nonempty transitive Galois set by [lem-exc-etale-field-galois-classification]. Since the action preserves components, equivariance makes their images land in one singleton target component Spec L′. The Hom-bijection of that classification produces a K-algebra map L′→L inducing the prescribed embedding map.

Apply the contravariant spectrum functor, transport via the singleton-open isomorphisms and compose with the target open immersion. The algebra map is over K and its embedding identity is the required formula for every geometric point of U. No x exists for an empty source; an empty target excludes a nonempty source by existence of a geometric point on U.

mathlib_searches.query: Equivariant maps on geometric points of etale schemes are locally induced by scheme morphisms
An equivariant map of geometric points of etale schemes over a field is induced locally by a morphism of schemes

lean.statement: theorem etaleFieldPointMap_local (K Ksep : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep] [IsSepClosure K Ksep] (X Y : Scheme.Etale (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (φ : etaleFieldGeometricAction K Ksep X ⟶ etaleFieldGeometricAction K Ksep Y) (x : X.left) : ∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ f : U.toScheme ⟶ Y.left, f ≫ Y.hom = U.ι ≫ X.hom ∧ ∀ (p : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ksep) ⟶ U.toScheme) (hp : p ≫ (U.ι ≫ X.hom) = (etaleFieldBasePoint K Ksep).hom), p ≫ f = (φ.hom (Over.homMk (p ≫ U.ι) (by simpa using hp))).left
